t: Why would someone buy a bond at a premium? | AccountingCoach
s: The amount of the bond premium = (actual future interest payments + actual maturity amount) discounted by the market interest rate at the time of the bond sale. A person would buy a bond at a premium (pay more than its maturity value) because the bond’s stated interest rate (and therefore the bond’s interest payments) will be greater than those expected by the current bond market.
